prompt: What information are you able to provide regarding the ESP32-C-Mini and what is your cut off date
response: The ESP32-C-Mini is a microcontroller board based on the ESP32-C3 chip. It supports Wi-Fi and Bluetooth and is suitable for various IoT applications. The cut-off date for the ESP32-C-Mini is not specified, implying it is still in production and supported. You can find detailed information and documentation on the Espressif Systems website.
